2610.12242.title: TokenRouter: Efficient Serving System for Token-Level LLM Routing
2610.12242.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) routing distributes inference work across different models, advancing the cost-quality Pareto frontier of LLM serving. While coarse-grained routing at the session or query level has been widely adopted in production systems, recent algorithmic work shows that fine-grained token-level routing can yield substantial efficiency and quality gains. However, efficiently serving token-level routed inference poses significant challenges to existing systems. Built on single-LLM assumptions, current systems suffer from severe step desynchronization and frequent batch admission delays under token-level routing, and they also impose high implementation complexity on developers. To address these challenges, we design TokenRouter, an efficient and developer-friendly serving system for token-level routed LLM inference. TokenRouter follows the principle of request-centric programming, model-centric execution: developers describe routing logic from the perspective of a single request, while the runtime launches a subserver for each LLM and dispatches requests asynchronously. Each subserver employs a delayed-batching scheduler, whose optimal hyperparameters are derived from a mathematical throughput model of the system. Across diverse routing algorithms, workloads, and model pairs, TokenRouter achieves 2.01-64.15x higher decoding throughput than existing systems, substantially advancing the serving efficiency of token-level LLM routing. Our code is available at https://github.com/thu-nics/TokenRouter.
2610.12242.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型 (LLM) 路由將推理工作分配到不同的模型上，推進了 LLM 服務的成本-品質帕累托邊界。雖然在會話或查詢層級的粗粒度路由已被廣泛應用於生產系統，但最近的算法研究顯示，細粒度的標記級路由可以帶來顯著的效率和品質提升。然而，有效地提供標記級路由的推理對現有系統提出了重大挑戰。基於單一 LLM 假設，目前的系統在標記級路由下遭受嚴重的步驟不同步和頻繁的批次接納延遲，並且對開發者施加了高實施複雜性。為了解決這些挑戰，我們設計了 TokenRouter，一個高效且對開發者友好的標記級路由 LLM 推理服務系統。TokenRouter 遵循請求中心編程和模型中心執行的原則：開發者從單一請求的角度描述路由邏輯，而運行時為每個 LLM 啟動一個子服務器並異步分發請求。每個子服務器使用延遲批次調度器，其最佳超參數是從系統的數學吞吐量模型中推導出來的。在多種路由算法、工作負載和模型對中，TokenRouter 的解碼吞吐量比現有系統高出 2.01-64.15 倍，顯著推進了標記級 LLM 路由的服務效率。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/thu-nics/TokenRouter 獲得。
